truth_to_say: I am accepted by grace, not performance.
I am a member of God's household.
He loves me, knows me and delights in me.
He knows I am dust, and there is no condemnation.
I am a new creation, and my life is hidden in Christ.

thought: "I have to be perfect to be loved."
truth_to_say: His power is perfected in my weakness.

thought: "I have to impress or please people."
truth_to_say: I serve Christ, who sees my heart.
Everything I have is a gift.
I have a gift and a place in the body, and I am not in a race.
I was forgiven far more, and I choose to forgive.

thought: "I have to win this or get even."
truth_to_say: I am slow to speak and slow to anger, and I overcome evil with good.
I am a member of a body that needs me and carries me.

thought: "They're beyond help, so I should write them off."
truth_to_say: I restore gently and speak truth in love.
I confess it, and I ask God to guard my mouth.

thought: "I'm anxious about the future or what people think."
truth_to_say: God cares for me, and I give him the worry.
God is greater than my heart; I take thoughts captive.

thought: "I can't tell what God wants from me."
truth_to_say: He has told me: love him, love people, be renewed, give thanks.
I am strong in the Lord, and the one in me is greater.

thought: "Doing good for people isn't worth it."
truth_to_say: My labor in the Lord is not in vain.
